name: WALKFLOW Demo — Consulting: Error Handling & Expired-Session Cleanup

parameters.content:
PREPARED, NOT TESTED. Combines two roles in one file, mirroring n8n-workflows/clinics/06-error-handling-cleanup.json:

(A) Error handling — set this as the Error Workflow (Workflow Settings > Error Workflow) on workflows 01–05, so any node failure there marks the originating job 'failed' in demo_consulting_jobs_queue with a real error code/message, rather than failing silently. Never surfaces internal error detail to the visitor — only the codes defined in src/lib/consulting-demo/contract.ts (DemoErrorCode).

(B) Expired-session cleanup — runs hourly, calling demo_consulting_cleanup_expired_sessions() (defined in supabase/migrations/0004_consulting_demo.sql). Deleting a session cascades to every table referencing it via ON DELETE CASCADE, including any open proposals or kickoffs — so a reset never leaves a stale pending job able to restore a cleared record.
